pin_wait: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {s} seconds.
free_tier_note: Free tier, so nothing is charged. Costs are estimates.
alert_service_down: {name} has stopped and will not restart on its own.
assistant_no_key: Add an API key so Trstenko can answer.
assistant_no_stt: Trstenko cannot hear you yet: speech recognition needs a key.
assistant_no_wake_word: The wake word could not be loaded.
assistant_tables: The assistant is off: its tables did not load.
banner_auth: The key for {provider} was refused. Check it in Settings.
banner_quota: {provider} says the account is out of credit or over its limit.
chart_label: Cost per day over the last {days} days
limit_hint: Leave a field empty for no limit. At 80% Trstenko says so once. At the limit it stops asking the provider.
memories_help: What Trstenko was told to remember. These go to the AI service with your questions, so delete anything you would rather it did not know.
key_works: It works. Trstenko will say hello.
key_failed: {provider} refused this key. Check that you copied all of it, or make a new one.
not_verified: Not yet tested against the real service.
http_note: The key travels over your home Wi-Fi to Trstenko. Use a key made only for Trstenko, with a spend limit set at the provider.
model_hint: Leave on default unless you know you want another.
fallback_hint: Used for one turn when the first is busy or out of credit.
location_hint: A town or city, for questions about the weather.
barge_in: Let me interrupt while it is speaking
barge_hint: Off by default: the device cannot always tell your voice from its own.
quiet_on: Turn the volume down at night
quiet_hint: Reminders are quiet. A timer you set rings at normal volume.
night_off: Switch the screen off during quiet hours
wake_hint: Raise it if you have to repeat yourself. Lower it if Trstenko wakes by itself.
vad_hint: How sure the device must be that you are still talking.
upd_not_checked: This device has not checked yet.
upd_no_summary: No summary was published with this release.
upd_install_note: Installing downloads it, unpacks it and restarts: a few minutes, and you do not need to stay on this page.
upd_urgent: {version} is an urgent update. It will install and restart on its own.
upd_hold: Hold it for a few hours
upd_postponed_note: The device will offer it again later.
upd_staged: {version} is downloaded and its checksum matches.
upd_waiting_turn: Waiting for the conversation to finish, then installing.
upd_waiting_told: Waiting to be told to install it.
upd_installing_note: Unpacking and building. The device restarts when it is done.
upd_restarting_note: This page will come back on its own. If the new version does not start, the device goes back to the previous release by itself.
upd_trial_note: It has a couple of minutes to come up properly. If it does not, the device returns to the previous release without being asked.
upd_revert: Go back to the previous release
conversation_log: Keep a log of the last 50 conversations
licences_body: Licences: Piper voice (GPL-3.0), wake word (Apache 2.0), Quicksand font (OFL).
setup_test_hint: Continue opens once the test passes.
setup_done_body: Say the wake word and ask for a timer.
sub_idle: Say the wake word, then ask.
sub_error: Trstenko could not answer that. Try again.
ai_notice: Answers are written by an AI service and can be wrong.
download_hint: Memories, reminders and usage as one file. Never your keys.
estimate_note: Costs are estimates from the provider’s prices.
face_asleep: Trstenko is waiting for the PIN
free_tier_switch: This key is on a free tier
free_tier_switch_hint: Trstenko cannot tell from the key. On a free tier the limits still count, but nothing is charged.
key_stored_hint: Trstenko stores the key and never shows it again.
language_hint: Trstenko listens and speaks in this language.
leaves_audio: When you ask something, the recording of your question goes to {provider}, which turns it into text and answers it.
leaves_memories: Your name and the memories Trstenko keeps go with it, so the answer can use them.
leaves_stays: Listening for the wake word, timers, reminders and the voice all stay on Trstenko. Nothing is sent while the microphone switch is off.
leaves_keys: Your API key goes only to the provider it belongs to, and this page never shows it again.
limit_reached: This month’s limit of {limit} is reached. Trstenko stops asking {provider} until {date}, or until you raise the limit.
limit_reached_short: This month’s limit of {limit} is reached. Questions are paused.
no_memories: Nothing saved yet. Say “remember that…” or add one below.
not_a_number: A limit has to be a number.
ollama_hint: The computer running Ollama, on the same network as Trstenko.
own_computer: Runs on your own computer, no key
paused_note: Questions are paused. Timers, reminders and the clock still work.
pin_help: Trstenko shows the PIN on its screen.
pin_hint: The PIN changes each time Trstenko restarts.
pin_wrong: That is not the PIN on Trstenko’s screen.
pinned_note: Pinned · always sent with a question
served_note: This page is served by Trstenko itself. Nothing here loads from the internet.
setup_help: Trstenko asks this service when you talk to it. Pick one and paste your key.
setup_passed: It works. Trstenko said hello out loud.
delete_body_memories: Trstenko forgets everything it was told to remember. This can’t be undone.
delete_body_log: The saved conversations are removed from Trstenko. This can’t be undone.
delete_body_usage: The cost per day is removed and the limits start counting from nothing. This can’t be undone.
wifi_help: Trstenko is on its own Wi-Fi for now. Pick your home network so it can reach the internet.
wifi_none: No networks found. Move Trstenko closer to your router and scan again.
wifi_joining_help: Trstenko has left its own Wi-Fi to join {ssid}. Put this phone back on {ssid} too, then open the page again and enter the PIN from Trstenko’s screen.
wifi_address_hint: If that address does not open, use the numbers shown on Trstenko’s screen. If the join fails, Trstenko’s own Wi-Fi comes back and this page says why.
reset_hint: Everything above, your keys, your settings and the Wi-Fi
reset_body: Memories, reminders, usage, API keys, settings and the Wi-Fi are all removed, and Trstenko restarts. This can’t be undone.
reset_done: Trstenko is starting again as new.
reset_done_body: In a minute its screen shows a Wi-Fi code and a new PIN. Join that Wi-Fi to set it up again.
pin_show: Show the PIN on Trstenko’s screen
pin_show_hint: On a long press of a volume button, and after joining Wi-Fi. Setup always shows it.
pin_new_hint: 6 to 10 digits. Other phones and tabs are signed out.
